name: labs/pyepics__newportxps
title: Newport XPS motion controller (newportxps.NewportXPS)
intro: Newport XPS motion controller (newportxps.NewportXPS), adapted from pyepics/newportxps. It reads `stage`, `group`, `position`, `group_status` and 3 more; runs `move_stage`, `move_stage_relative`, `home_group`, `enable_group` and 2 more. `move_stage`: move the bound stage to an absolute position in controller user units. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/pyepics__newportxps --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/pyepics__newportxps --backend fake --mcp
